.PHONY: test test-fast

test-fast:

test:
	pytest -q
8:dev = ["pytest>=8.0"]
tests/test_payments.py:7:@pytest.mark.integration

I can't tell you the `just` command from this checkout, because it still contains the Makefile and has no justfile (and `just` isn't installed here). Your branch may differ from what I'm looking at.

The old Makefile ran the fast tests as:

```
pytest -m "not postgres" -q
```

You can run that directly. It skips the Postgres tests, and `just test` presumably runs the full suite (the old `make test` needed `docker compose up db`).

There's a catch with that marker. The only marked test I found is `tests/test_payments.py`, and it's marked `integration`, not `postgres`. The `not postgres` filter may therefore not exclude anything. Try `pytest -m "not integration" -q` if you want to skip it.

If your justfile defines a fast recipe, `just --list` will show its name. If it doesn't have one, a recipe like this would replace the old target:

```just
test-fast:
    pytest -m "not postgres" -q
```
